brief.text: Individual purchases were led by massive commitments, headlined by Baker Bros. Advisors placing $35.0 million into MDGL and $24.3 million into KOD, alongside Richard Kinder’s $15.0 million purchase in KMI. Within cluster activity, UPBD drew an unusually high seven distinct insiders totaling $1.39 million, while TTMI captured the largest overall cluster total at $3.62 million. Additionally, quiet patterns emerge across the rows: Saba Capital Management filed purchases across four separate funds (JOF, MXF, ECF, GRX), and Real Estate Investment Trusts BXMT and FBRT each topped $1 million in multi-insider volume.
